image_description: A large African crocodile (Nile crocodile) is basking on a sandy riverbank with its mouth open. The crocodile's body is elongated and covered in dark, textured scutes. The background shows green vegetation and a sandy bank. There is a timestamp overlay at the bottom of the image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible and shows the characteristic broad, triangular shape with a V-shaped snout typical of crocodiles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is open in a basking posture, so teeth visibility when mouth is closed cannot be verified. However, the massive jaws are evident.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes are positioned on top of the head as expected. Vertical slit pupils are visible, though the nictitating membrane is not clearly discernible at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Nostrils are visible at the tip of the snout as expected for crocodiles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is clearly elongated and covered in thick, bony scutes giving it an armored appearance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal surface shows clear rows of thick, bony scutes arranged longitudinally.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The scutes are dark in color with a rough, textured appearance consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface is not visible as the crocodile is lying on its belly on the ground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are visible and appear short and stout. Webbing is visible on the feet, though exact digit count is difficult to verify at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible and appears laterally compressed and muscular, consistent with the expected proportion of body length.
